includedCredentialTemplate: .env.example contains placeholder values only; no live credentials were found.
externalResourceNotes: HTML demos/specimens reference Google Fonts hosts and some CDN-hosted packages; these are upstream remote runtime references and were not downloaded or rewritten.
README links and YouTube preview resources are remote documentation media, not missing tracked repository files.
Voiceover examples reference generated audio outputs such as voiceover.mp3; these outputs are not tracked and are expected to be produced by the example workflow.
Optional cloud scripts require user-supplied provider credentials; only the placeholder .env.example is included.
hashBasis: Unmodified files use raw Git blob bytes from the pinned upstream commit. Customized files record their bundled size and SHA-256 plus upstreamSizeBytes/upstreamSha256; excluded files keep their original metadata and removal reason.
